shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "ls -la; rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!public/**'"'; find .. -name AGENTS.md -print; cat package.json; cat src/App.tsx; cat src/main.tsx; cat index.html"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'configure|setLang|I18n|lang' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/config* node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/i18n* node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/{Select,DatePicker,Pagination,Table,Dialog,TextInput}/*.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat tsconfig.json; git status --short; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit"
